'''March 2001 Augusta tournament (constructed)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Augusta, GA in March 2001. Art won it. It is known from Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1980">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-31-augusta-ga-its-go-timed1980/ augusta-ga-its-go-time], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 31 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-31-augusta-ga-its-go-timed1980/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' March 2001
* '''Site:''' Augusta, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' Art
